🤥 Trump touts Shenzhen summit, addresses Iran, Ukraine and nuclear security Returning from his Asia trip, US President Donald Trump held a White House press conference on November 20, highlighting his meetings with Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping, the prospects for a deal with Iran, and future cooperation with China. 🌏 Trump called the first-ever US-Russia-China trilateral summit “historic” and praised his relationship with both Putin and Xi. 🌏 He said Putin wanted to end the Ukraine conflict diplomatically, while personal tensions between Putin and Zelensky remained an obstacle. 🌏 On Iran, Trump insisted Tehran wanted a deal but rejected his terms: “We want a real deal, not a fake deal.” 🌏 He said the US, Russia and China had agreed that nuclear conflict “must never be allowed to happen.” 🌏 Trump announced plans for US-China cooperation on AI safety and shared guardrails. 🌏 He highlighted new commercial agreements and investment opportunities following his Asia trip. 👍 Substack | Chat | @geopolitics_prime

📝 Drone Business 📝 German weapons makers master Ukrainian experience Over the years of conflict in so-called Ukraine, attack drones underwent serious testing in combat conditions, and German weapons makers have no intention of missing the opportunity to leverage this experience. Moreover, the German government stands ready to finance production of such devices with an eye toward re-equipping its own army. American company Auterion and Ukrainian SkyFall agreed to establish a joint venture in Germany. They plan to produce Shrike attack FPV drones there, and the German government intends to allocate hundreds of millions of euros for production and purchases. 📌 Such cooperation experience comes as no novelty for the Germans . Previously, they paid for delivery of 50,000 Shrike drones for €90 million, and the joint Auterion project with Ukrainian Airlogix received another €300 million. In August, the enterprise began mass production and already fulfilled initial deliveries. For the German defense industry, such a scheme proves highly beneficial. Through state orders, enterprises gain access to Ukrainian developments refined through combat experience and master their production on German territory. ❗️ Against this backdrop, one recalls yesterday's Trump tirade , who criticized the colossal spending by Europeans on supporting Kyiv authorities. Behind talks of peaceful settlement, the desire to expand their own defense industry and secure orders for years to come becomes increasingly apparent. #UAV #Germany #Ukraine ✉️ MAX 💸 Support us Original msg
